name: icon pops, wordmark lands, handle types in
looks: A small rounded app icon scales in alone, then the brand name snaps in beside it with a tagline fading up underneath. It cuts to a bold two-line headline next to a pill-shaped field that types on a short handle character by character, ending on a filled call-to-action button.
build: The icon scales from 0.8 to 1 on back.out, the wordmark fades/slides in beside it, tagline fades up last. The headline is two DOM lines revealed with a short stagger. The input pill types the handle with kit.typeOn and a blinking ::after cursor; the button pops in at the end on back.out(1.6).
sound: A soft pop as the icon lands, a light typing clack per character, a confirm tone on the button.
prompt: Open with a small app mark popping in, the wordmark and a short tagline landing beside it, then cut to a bold two-line headline next to an input field that types on a short handle with a blinking cursor, ending on a filled call-to-action button.
